Total Solar Eclipse Visible Across Spain, Drawing Large Crowds

A rare total solar eclipse was witnessed across Spain, drawing millions of spectators to cities. The celestial event was also partially visible in parts of Africa. International wire coverage highlighted the spectacle, with some outlets sharing photos and videos, and others noting the emotional impact on viewers. Some reports also looked ahead to future eclipses, such as the one predicted for 2027.
